## Notes

This is the PR containing all the changes for the Project API. Its main purpose is to have all the changes in one place and make the code available for testing and checking the features. Feel free to leave general comments here. 

For context please see the [Project API](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/discussions/issues/466) discussion.

The documentation how to use this can be found [here](https://codeberg.org/telekom-mms/forgejo-docs/src/branch/project-api-ideas/docs/user/project-api/index.md). Eventually we'll also do a PR against the docs repo, but for now the documentation and the code here are subject to change.

This PR will be split into smaller sections in the coming days.
